messages:
Iris (Design): quick thread about the batch export & preview UX — noticed a couple things in the mock: column chooser is buried and export modal copy is vague. can we review wording + accessibility?
Tomas (Eng): sure. specifics?
Iris (Design): 1) export label currently 'Download vectors' — propose 'Export vectors (CSV)'. 2) explain what columns will be in CSV: ids, vector dims (truncated), rerank_score, score_percentile if enabled. 3) give clearer header naming for vector components.
Ravi (PM): header naming is important for downstream integration. dev teams expect vector_0..vector_N or a single base64 column. can we provide both options?
Omar (ML): offering both is sensible. default: vector_0..vector_n for easier analysis; advanced option: compressed_base64 for compactness. note: warn about size overhead in CSV.
Bea (A11y): accessibility points: export action should announce progress via polite live region and keyboard focus must move into the export modal. when export completes, announce "Export ready: file queued" and allow keyboard to return to table.
Tomas (Eng): we'll implement export as a background job if >5k rows and provide a download link + optional email. live region can say "Export started: you will be notified when ready." then update with percent if feasible.
Iris (Design): flow idea: if export is large, show modal: "Large export — streaming job will run in background. We'll email you when ready. Or choose sample." give sampling presets: First N, Random N, Stratified by score bucket, and Column-only export (no vectors).
Ravi (PM): include a recommendation: "We recommend sampling for exports over 10k rows to avoid timeouts." Also add analytics for export_type and sample_method.
Omar (ML): for stratified sampling, define default buckets (0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). we should show expected row counts per bucket in the modal to help users decide.
Bea (A11y): column chooser must be keyboard operable and support aria-checked on options. the table should use role=grid and each column should expose aria-sort when sortable. column presets must have accessible labels.
Tomas (Eng): ok. also performance note: rendering many columns + dense vectors fries the DOM. we'll add a column pinning feature and collapse vector columns behind a single expandable cell by default.
Iris (Design): good call — default table shows a "Vectors" collapsed cell with "dims: 768" and a chevron to expand. include aria-expanded state. provide a keyboard shortcut to expand focused row.
Ravi (PM): product ask: persist column presets per-user and emit event when users change presets so we can measure adoption.
Omar (ML): copy tweak for rerank score column: show both raw score and percentile toggle. default to raw, with tooltip: "Toggle to view percentile rank of score." for non-technical users percentile may be more intuitive.
Bea (A11y): toggles need aria-pressed and proper focus styles. avoid tooltip-only explanations — provide sr-only helper text and aria-describedby references as well.
ci-bot: preview build for branch feature/export-ux-ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/export-ux-ready
Tomas (Eng): can folks test staging with screen readers and also try huge exports to validate background job flow? I'll add a checklist to the PR.
Iris (Design): I'll update the mocks with the modal copy, sampling presets, and the collapsed vectors pattern. tagging Bea for accessibility review when PR is live.
Ravi (PM): timeline: aim to ship behind FF in two weeks. blockers?
Bea (A11y): blocking if live-region announcements + keyboard modal focus not implemented in PR. otherwise fine.
Iris (Design): thanks everyone — adding notes to design doc and will ping once PR is ready. :thumbsup:
